intro_html: Accounting Audit Reports gives Odoo Community the printouts it lacks: a general ledger with opening balances, a partner statement showing what each customer or vendor still owes, an ageing of overdue items, a tax report and a journals audit. Answering an auditor, or a customer's “what do we owe?”, takes one click instead of a spreadsheet rebuilt by hand.

features.title: General ledger
features.desc: Every account with a running balance, opening with the balance carried in from before the start date.

features.title: Partner ledger
features.desc: One block per customer or vendor with the amount still owed; also printable from a contact.

features.title: Aged balance
features.desc: Open items in ageing buckets as of any date, with receivable and payable presets.

features.title: Tax report
features.desc: Net and tax per tax, sales and purchases apart; credit notes reduce the figures.

features.title: Journals audit
features.desc: One section per journal with totals and a tax recap under each journal that carries tax.

features.title: Journal entry printout
features.desc: Any entry on its own page, in its own company's letterhead and currency.

features.title: Journal item screens
features.desc: Items by account and by partner in list, pivot and graph, for questions a PDF cannot answer.

features.title: Read-only, six languages
features.desc: Writes nothing to your books and uses no elevated access; Ukrainian, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese.

limitations: All figures are in the company currency; nothing is converted.
PDF only. For a spreadsheet, use the two journal item screens.
The aged balance covers every journal of the company by design.
The PDFs are static: they do not link back into Odoo.
Known gap: the ageing headings read "1 - 30", "31 - 60" and so on, with a first column headed "Not Due". The amounts sit in the right columns.
Known gap: the General Ledger's Opening Balance row shows no debit or credit. Its balance is correct.
Known gap: the tax table under each journal in the Journals Audit has no heading.
Known gap: in the landscape reports the narrow Entry column can wrap an entry number onto a second line.
Known gap: the Journal Entry PDF downloads under the default file name, and a few field and option labels differ from the written specification.
Not verified: the optional Currency column with several currencies in use, and every dialog clicked by hand in a browser. Figures were checked against the database and rendered PDFs.
